newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel differentials steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel differentials steady.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel and unleaded gasoline differentials were largely steady late Tuesday ahead of the weekly inventory estimates, traders said.
The weekly stocks estimates indicated a modest draw in distillates and unleaded gasoline, but not a deep enough draw to spark active spot trading, traders said.
The American Petroleum Institute said PADD II Midwest distillate stocks were down 121,000 barrels and gasoline stocks were down 594,000 barrels on the week.
Chicago winter-grade unleaded was bid 6.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded, with summer-grade barrels talked 2.25 cents a gallon under the print in late-afternoon discussion.
Group Three unleaded gasoline eased to 3.75/3.50 cents a gallon under the print for late-month deliveries.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 3.25 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Chicago and eased to 3.85 cents over the print in Group Three.
